title: Bsd Saturation Adapter
objective: Convert self-contained full-Mordell-Weil saturation proofs into closed replayable BSD subgroup-index certificates bound to the original basis and regulator

oracles: SaturationResult replay and BSD closed certificate verifier

handoff.summary: Adds a closed replayable BSD subgroup-index certificate for the original ordered Mumford basis of a full-Mordell-Weil SaturationResult, together with fixed BSD-bound saturation assumption authorities and conditional handling of arbitrary callbacks.
risks: The fixed BSD-bound authority proves only claims already represented by certified/proved BSD arithmetic input; other verifier authorities intentionally remain external_unverified.
Broad native, SEA, and Wasm validation is deferred to the integration lane because this lane changes ordinary Python only.
next_steps: Integration should expose the three helper functions through the shared hyperelliptic public API.
Run centralized architecture, native, SEA, and Wasm gates after merging all BSD lanes.
